implementation: Isolated copies of the original carried native PV and compacted exact replay replace only volatile FP32 accumulator-times-alpha temporaries with the existing explicit AMD v_mul_f32 register rounding barrier. A second variant evaluates the unchanged table-derived reciprocal once per query/head and shares that exact value. The copied control changes neither choice. Original native error recurrence, K16 integer canonical endpoints, collection and complete replay are unchanged. Production does not include this experimental header.
correctness_scope: 1048576 GPU original-volatile versus register multiplication pairs include random finite carries and zero, signed zero, subnormal, maximum, infinity and NaN edge cases with finite alphas in [0,1]. 84 generated cases cover seven causal shapes, six score/value families and both butterfly orders; each compares three variants. Every native pre-replay raw output, accumulator, denominator and error surface matches original arithmetic. Original candidate membership and every complete corrected raw surface match; all outputs also match original all-cell replay in BF16. 672 distinct CPU full PV dots and CPU original reciprocal checks add independent observations. Short reciprocal/candidate workspace rejection, immutable inputs, guards and unused tails are checked. Captures compare all prepared scores with independent original tiled QK and every original GB10 context cell on every attempt. The q8192 extension repeats the first1023 captured Q/K/V rows; it is not a new model token loop.
timing_scope: One warmup and three rotated completed host samples per128-query slab in one executable. The PV owner includes native production, optional row-reciprocal preparation, count initialization, collection and complete exact replay. Allocation, workspace reset and observation are outside timers. QK, original probability generation, input preparation and V transpose are reported separately. No model load or TTFT is measured.

decision.decision: Advance register-only rescaling to a default-off production option and same-DLL real-model GB10 comparison. Both captures improve with identical original raw surfaces and unchanged replay work. Keep shared row reciprocals isolated: their incremental saving is1.7614ms atq7169 and1.3510ms atq8192, with additional workspace and launch ownership.
